answer.answer: APY offers a guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1000/-, Rs. 2000/-, Rs. 3000/-, Rs. 4000/-, or Rs. 5000/- per month after age 60 until death [E01][E02]. The life-insurance programme that covers death from any cause is Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY), which offers a one-year renewable term life cover of Rs. 2.00 Lakh for death due to any reason [E03].
